typical_delay.value: a few minutes to 24 hours for the restore to start (objects larger than 1 MB); no estimate per use case
typical_delay.note: FAQ: 'anywhere from a few minutes to 24 hours for restore to start (for objects larger than 1 MB)'; Scaleway cannot estimate retrieval times per use case.

notes: Glacier is available from buckets in Paris and Amsterdam; it is not yet possible to transfer files to Glacier in Warsaw (FAQ checked 2026-10-13).
Objects must be restored before they can be read; restored content goes to Standard Multi-AZ when available in the bucket's region, otherwise One Zone (Specific Conditions, version 07/04/2026).

free_allowance_gb_per_month.note: Pricing page: 'Egress: 75GB free every month then EUR 0.01/GB' (rendered for Paris; the text comes from a region-independent page template). Scope across projects or regions is not stated.

egress.free_allowance_scope: Per month, as listed on the pricing page; scope across projects or regions was not verified.

price.note: Pricing page: EUR 0.01/GB after the free allowance (the unit is printed as 'GB / MONTH'; interpreted as per GB transferred). The embedded price data has EUR 0.01 for SKU /storage/obj/bandwidth/to-external/<region> in fr-par, nl-ams, pl-waw and it-mil.

notes: Inter-regional transfer is counted as egress; intra-regional transfer (PAR-PAR, AMS-AMS, WAW-WAW) is free of charge (pricing page footnote). The Specific Conditions also state that outgoing traffic to another Scaleway region is charged like traffic to the internet.

egress_fair_use.note: No fair-use rule for egress is stated on the pricing page, FAQ or Specific Conditions Storage checked on 2026-10-13.

object_lock.note: Supported on Standard Multi-AZ, Standard One Zone and Glacier; only in buckets with versioning enabled; once enabled it cannot be disabled and versioning cannot be suspended.

free_tier.value: 75 GB of egress free every month. New-user trial: 750 GB of free storage in total across Standard Multi-AZ and Standard One Zone for 90 days, for accounts that never used Standard Multi-AZ before 30 November 2023; excess Multi-AZ storage during the trial is billed.
free_tier.note: The 75 GB egress allowance is from the pricing page and is modelled under egress; the trial is not modelled.
